content:
[Intro]
[Csus2]
[Cm]

[Pre-Verse 1]
[C5]

[Verse 1]
[C5]On the first light
of the day, you
march on
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]Departure has ar-
rived, don't look
back
[C5]Avoid the darkness,
stay away, stay
out of sight
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]Until you feel the
blast of a shooting
star

[Interlude]
[C5]

[Verse 2]
[C5]Following the
spark like a rocket
in the sky
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]Between the bear and the
scorpion, getting
close
[C5]Headed north, frozen
land where tigers
go to die
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]Don't fear the cold, it'll
numb your memories
out

[Bridge]
[Eb5]
You are
[D5]higher
[Eb5]
in the sky
[D5]

[Verse 3]
[C5]Learn the skill to
stay alive, sur-
vival
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]The city is so
mean, you're being
watched
[C5]Reach the tunnel,
light the torch, you're
on the hunt
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]Until the light calls you
back into the
wild

[Solo]
[C5]

[Verse 4]
[C5]When you get to the
other side, please,
send a sign
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]It'll fly through the
atmosphere in
time
[C5]And if you
hold the truth with-
in your hands
[F5]  [Eb5]  [D5]
[C5]You won't be sent back,
through the rain, re-
born

[Chorus]
[C5]
[Bbsus2]
[C5]
[Bbsus2]
[C5]
[Bbsus2]
[C5]
[Bbsus2]

[Bbsus2]
[C5]
[Bbsus2]
[C5]Everlasting
[Bbsus2]love is ever
[C5]growing,
[Bbsus2]growing
[C5]Hang on to what you
[Bbsus2]have and let it
[C5]grow
[Bbsus2]
[C5]Everlasting
[Bbsus2]love is ever
[C5]dying,
[Bbsus2]dying
[C5]It's in the past, you
[Bbsus2]have to let it
[C5]go
[Bbsus2]

[Outro]
[Cm]
[Bb]
[Ab]
[Cm]

[Cm]
